rule: Asterisks are rendered by assets/js/prism-forms.js from the live required/aria-required state of enabled, editable controls. Read-only, disabled and hidden-input controls are never marked. Optional fields were not made mandatory.

forms.backend: onboarding_finish(): name, ID, department from catalog

forms.optional: Email, Role, Student ID read only
